title: 他与她的梦 12他与她的梦 11
lines: 格林离开酒馆后，顺着告示牌的指引向北走去。
街道两旁的建筑逐渐变得低矮，路灯的间距越来越大，光线越来越暗。那些漫无目的的行人渐渐少了，取而代之的是更加纯粹一点的怪物，已经大片的空地，杂草丛生，偶尔能看到锈蚀的长椅和倒塌的秋千架。
然后他进入了那片公园。
雾气从地面升腾起来，薄薄的，像一层被撕碎的纱。路灯在雾中发出昏黄的光晕，照亮周围几米的距离，再远就是一片模糊的白。脚下的石板路蜿蜒着向前延伸，消失在雾气的深处。
格林走着，他走了大概五分钟，看见了一座喷泉。
石砌的，底部已经长满了青苔。泉水早已干涸，只剩下底部一层暗色的积水，映着路灯的光，像一面破碎的镜子。
格林绕过喷泉，继续向前走。
又走了大概五分钟——他又看见了那座喷泉。
石砌的，底部长满了青苔，干涸的泉水和那层暗色的积水。
一模一样。
格林停下脚步。
他环顾四周，雾气在路灯下缓缓流动，树木的轮廓在雾中若隐若现。没有行人，没有声音，只有那些昏黄的灯光和他自己的呼吸。
格林沉默了片刻，然后他再次迈步。这次他换了一个方向——向左转，穿过一条两排树之间的小径，然后沿着一条似乎是新的路线向前走。
五分钟后。
还是那个喷泉。
格林站在喷泉前，看着那些青苔和积水。
他的眉头微微皱起。
烦，那股烦闷感再次涌上来，像一口被堵住的井，水面在慢慢升高。他的手指微微收紧，指甲嵌进掌心。
很显然，这地方在阻止他找爱丽丝，所以需要摧毁掉。
格林抬起手。
魔力在掌中凝聚，先是细微的，然后越来越浓郁。金色的光芒从指缝间溢出，渐渐聚拢成一团。那团光在变大，颜色也在变化——从金色变成橙红，又从橙红变成一种炽烈的白。
火球在高温在空气中辐射开，周围的雾气被驱散了一小片，露出干燥的石板路面。
在格林打算直接用魔法将这里摧毁的时候，一道声音从侧面传来。
格林转头。
柴郡猫坐在喷泉的边缘，双腿悬空晃荡着。她不知道什么时候来的，也不知道在那里坐了多久。
她一只手撑着下巴，另一只手轻轻拨弄着干涸喷泉里的积水，指尖划过水面，带起细细的涟漪。
不用这样做吧？她说，语气轻松，“只要按照有路灯的那边走就可以了喵。”
“……”格林看着她，慢慢说道：“你不是要睡觉吗？怎么跟过来了。”
content_en:
After Green left the tavern, he followed the sign and walked north.
The buildings on both sides of the street gradually become lower, the distance between streetlights becomes wider and wider, and the light becomes darker and darker. Those aimless pedestrians gradually disappeared, replaced by purer monsters. There were already large open spaces, overgrown with weeds, and occasionally rusted benches and collapsed swings could be seen.
Then he entered the park.
The mist rose from the ground, thin, like a torn yarn. The street lamps emitted a dim yellow halo in the fog, illuminating the surroundings for a few meters, and even further away was a blur of white. The stone road beneath your feet snakes forward and disappears into the depths of the mist.
Green was walking. He walked for about five minutes and saw a fountain.
It was made of stone, and the bottom was already covered with moss. The spring water has dried up long ago, leaving only a layer of dark water at the bottom, which reflects the light of the street lamp like a broken mirror.
Green walked around the fountain and continued walking forward.
After walking for about five minutes - he saw the fountain again.
It is made of stone, and the bottom is covered with moss, dry spring water and a layer of dark stagnant water.
Exactly the same.
Green stopped.
He looked around. The fog was flowing slowly under the street lights, and the outlines of trees were looming in the fog. There were no pedestrians, no sounds, just those dim lights and his own breathing.
"..."
Green was silent for a moment, then he took another step. This time he went in a different direction—turned left, crossed a path between two rows of trees, and followed what seemed to be a new route.
Five minutes later.
It's the same fountain.
Green stood in front of the fountain, looking at the moss and standing water.
His brows furrowed slightly.
Annoyance, that feeling of boredom came up again, like a blocked well, the water level was slowly rising. His fingers tightened slightly, and his nails dug into his palms.
It was obvious that this place was preventing him from finding Alice, so it needed to be destroyed.
Green raised his hand.
The magic power condenses in the palm, subtle at first, and then more and more intense. Golden light overflowed from between the fingers and gradually gathered into a ball. The light grew larger and changed color—from gold to orange-red, and from orange-red to a blazing white.
The fireball radiated in the air at high temperature, and the surrounding fog was dispersed to a small extent, revealing the dry stone pavement.
"——Meow."
When Green was about to use magic to destroy this place, a voice came from the side.
Green turned his head.
The Cheshire Cat sat on the edge of the fountain, legs dangling in the air. She didn't know when she came or how long she had been sitting there.
She supported her chin with one hand, and gently fiddled with the accumulated water in the dry fountain with the other hand. Her fingertips traced the water, causing thin ripples.
You don’t have to do this, right? She said, her tone relaxed, "Just follow the side with the street lights, meow."
"..." Green looked at her and said slowly: "Aren't you going to sleep? Why did you follow me here?"
